about: I'm a software engineer with 2+ years of production experience building distributed systems and backend services. I work with Go, Python, Java, PostgreSQL, and AWS, and enjoy owning features from design through deployment. I'm also building AI agents and LLM experiences that turn complex systems into useful products.

experiences.description: Data Analyst since September 2026. Further details about this role will be shared when available.
Built a serverless Lambda classifier that tags 30,000+ recipes and automated weekly ingestion of 1,000+ media assets into S3 and PostgreSQL.
Reduced recipe API latency from 500ms to 150ms with Redis caching and pagination; supported content and landing page operations.
Built a logistics pricing engine that reduced quote turnaround from four hours to under one minute and cut Go dashboard API p99 latency from 3s to 600ms.
Analyzed datasets and supported process improvements through data-driven reporting.
Mentored peers, resolved code issues, and collaborated on application performance improvements.
Built a Python-based invoice application and worked on deadline prediction using machine learning.
